$comment: Your design system, expressed as the rules the build is checked against.

color.$comment: toleranceDeltaE: how far a rendered colour may sit from the nearest token before it is reported.

spacing.$comment: Padding and margin are expected to be multiples of basePx.

performance.$comment: Developer-side limits. Warn is a target, fail is a P1.

targetSize.$comment: WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.8 (AA) is 24x24. Use 44 for SC 2.5.5 (AAA).
